name: Combo
description: Product group card shown in the #combos rail. Marketing creates and edits combos in Admin without touching code. Deal price and compare-at (sum of MRPs) live here; the save line is always computed in Liquid from them - never hardcoded.

field_definitions.name: Description
field_definitions.description: Rendered as the "Includes: ..." copy on the card.

field_definitions.name: Items
field_definitions.description: Tray stack, order preserved. Each item references a `combo_item` metaobject.

field_definitions.name: Price
field_definitions.description: Deal price shown on the card (store currency).

field_definitions.name: Compare-at price
field_definitions.description: Sum of the products' MRPs, for the strikethrough + computed save row. Empty hides the save row.

field_definitions.name: Save line
field_definitions.description: Optional override for the save pill (e.g. "Biggest saving"). Empty = computed from price vs compare-at.

field_definitions.name: Flag
field_definitions.description: Teal corner pill, e.g. "Most popular". Empty hides it.

field_definitions.name: Highlight
field_definitions.description: Hero variant: amber ring + primary CTA.

field_definitions.name: Fine print
field_definitions.description: Small print under the price row, e.g. "Inclusive of all taxes · COD available".

field_definitions.name: CTA label
field_definitions.description: Button label, e.g. "Shop bundle". Empty falls back to the section default.

field_definitions.name: CTA link
field_definitions.description: Where "Shop bundle" goes. Empty falls back to the section default link.
